logp.method_description: The partition coefficient measurements were performed according to the previously reported method [34, 35]. In each centrifuge tube, 0.1 mL of 99mTc(CO)3-complex was mixed with 0.7 mL of the 1-octanol and 0.6 mL of phosphate buffer (0.025 mol/L, pH 7.4). After vortexed for 3 min and centrifuged at 10000 g for 5 min, the clearly separated two layers were obtained. Three samples (100 µL) from 1-octanol and phosphate buffer were pipetted and measured in a γ-counter, and each group was repeated three times. The partition coefficient was calculated by the equation: Log P = Log [(counts in 1-octanol layer)/(counts in aqueous layer)].
